measurement_basis.round_noise_policy: Use the maximum observed per-round p95 as the measured p95 used for an absolute trend ceiling; use the maximum paired per-round composition-p95/calibration-p95 ratio, also respecting the minimum observed calibration p95 across the formal baseline and reduced gate-validation capture when preserving a historical ceiling, for the normalized gate. Neither margin is an arbitrary pass multiplier.
measurement_basis.calibration: Each benchmark execution decodes the same 68-byte in-memory PNG 100000 times per calibration sample with QImage.fromData; payload SHA-256 is 431ced6916a2a21a156e38701afe55bbd7f88969fbbfc56d7fe099d47f265460.
measurement_basis.workload: Production LayeredFullBodyRenderer and LayeredParametricFaceRenderer with the shipped official blue-white Hanfu outfit and classic makeup. Full-body cold starts a fresh renderer and clears QPixmapCache; hot switches warm both endpoints before timing; half-body switches cheek-rest to front-crossed after both are warm.
measurement_basis.scope: Offscreen compositor calls only; excludes the UI event loop, adapter publication, and unrelated window layout work.

environment.label: Developer known hardware
environment.description: The recorded Windows development workstation. A non-CI run must match every field below; otherwise the test fails closed.

measurement.source: Fresh local calibrated baseline run in this worktree.

calibration.gate_floor_source: Observed during a reduced developer gate-validation run with 5 composition samples and 1 composition round; retained as the observed calibration lower bound.
calibration.method: Five rounds of five samples; each sample decodes the fixed in-memory PNG 100000 times.

developer_known_hardware.margin_policy: Absolute trend ceiling uses the maximum known-hardware per-round p95 and preserves the previously accepted 1482.498 ms cold-start ceiling. Ratio gate margin uses the maximum paired round ratio and, for the preserved historical ceiling, the minimum observed calibration p95 across the formal baseline and reduced gate-validation capture (833.677 ms); no arbitrary multiplier is added.

cold_full_body.margin: Absolute: 1482.498 ms is the maximum previously accepted known-hardware round p95; current calibrated capture is 1406.008 ms. Ratio: max paired round ratio 1.453951, while the preserved historical ceiling normalized by the observed reduced-gate calibration floor is 1482.498/833.677 = 1.778264.
cold_full_body.formula: absolute_budget_ms = max(previous accepted known-hardware ceiling 1482.498, current measured_p95_ms 1406.008) = 1482.498; ratio_budget = max(maximum paired per-round composition p95 / calibration p95 1.453951, historical absolute ceiling / observed reduced-gate calibration floor 1482.498/833.677 = 1.778264) = 1.778264.
cold_full_body.reason: The measured cold-start cost remains above the owner's 300 ms target. Keep over_target=true and use the visible absolute value for trend; the cross-machine regression gate uses the calibrated ratio.

hot_full_body_view_switch.margin: Absolute: owner target 100.0 ms is the looser documented ceiling. Ratio: maximum paired round ratio is 0.004995; the maximum composition round p95 normalized by the minimum calibration round p95 is 5.015/967.026 = 0.005186.
hot_full_body_view_switch.formula: absolute_budget_ms = max(current measured p95 x 1.5, owner target) = 100.0 ms; ratio_budget = max(maximum paired per-round composition p95 / calibration p95 0.004995, maximum composition round p95 / minimum calibration round p95 5.015/967.026 = 0.005186) = 0.005186.
hot_full_body_view_switch.reason: The warmed full-body view switch is below the owner's 100 ms target; retain the target-based absolute trend ceiling and use the paired calibrated ratio for CI.

hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.margin: Absolute: owner target 100.0 ms is the looser documented ceiling. Ratio: maximum paired round ratio is 0.006223; the maximum composition round p95 normalized by the minimum calibration round p95 is 6.062/967.026 = 0.006269.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.formula: absolute_budget_ms = max(current measured p95 x 1.5, owner target) = 100.0 ms; ratio_budget = max(maximum paired per-round composition p95 / calibration p95 0.006223, maximum composition round p95 / minimum calibration round p95 6.062/967.026 = 0.006269) = 0.006269.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.reason: The warmed half-body silhouette switch is below the owner's 100 ms target; retain the target-based absolute trend ceiling and use the paired calibrated ratio for CI.

environment.label: CI runner
environment.description: A hosted CI runner identified by GITHUB_ACTIONS=true or CI=true. The runner's absolute speed is not assumed to match the development workstation.

measurement.source: PR #170 failed Windows CI log; only the retry's cold_full_body p95 is available.

calibration.method: Measured at runtime in the same benchmark execution; no calibration output was persisted by the failed historical run.

ci_runner.margin_policy: The one independent CI run is insufficient to establish an absolute CI threshold, so CI absolute values are record-only. The active gate uses the developer-known-hardware ratio threshold with a fresh same-run calibration; missing or undersampled calibration fails closed.

absolute_gate.reason: 1722.333 ms is the only captured CI cold-start p95. Do not turn one hosted-run observation into an absolute threshold.

cold_full_body.margin: Absolute CI value is record-only because independent_runs=1; active margin is the developer-known-hardware normalized ratio threshold.
cold_full_body.formula: absolute_budget_ms is intentionally unset; active ratio_budget is inherited from the developer-known-hardware ceiling normalized by the observed reduced-gate calibration floor = 1.778264.
cold_full_body.reason: 1722.333 ms is a single hosted-run observation, so it records the trend but cannot establish an absolute CI gate; the normalized ratio remains active.

hot_full_body_view_switch.margin: Absolute CI value is not established; active margin is the developer-known-hardware normalized ratio threshold.
hot_full_body_view_switch.formula: absolute_budget_ms is intentionally unset; active ratio_budget is inherited from the developer-known-hardware noise ceiling = 0.005186.
hot_full_body_view_switch.reason: No historical CI hot-switch p95 was captured; measure it at runtime and gate its normalized ratio against the recorded developer noise ceiling.
hot_full_body_view_switch.status: not captured in the failed historical run; measured at runtime

hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.margin: Absolute CI value is not established; active margin is the developer-known-hardware normalized ratio threshold.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.formula: absolute_budget_ms is intentionally unset; active ratio_budget is inherited from the developer-known-hardware noise ceiling = 0.006269.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.reason: No historical CI hot-switch p95 was captured; measure it at runtime and gate its normalized ratio against the recorded developer noise ceiling.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.status: not captured in the failed historical run; measured at runtime

ci_gate.profile_selection: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true or CI=true selects ci_runner; otherwise the benchmark environment must exactly match developer_known_hardware. Any other state fails closed.
ci_gate.comparison: For every metric, observed measurements.*.summary.p95_ms / calibration.summary.p95_ms must be less than or equal to the selected ratio threshold.
ci_gate.absolute_ci_record_only_reason: One independent CI run (including the 1722.333 ms cold_full_body observation) is insufficient to set a stable absolute hosted-run threshold; normalized same-run ratios remain an active regression gate.
fail_closed_conditions: calibration or compositor sample count below minimum_runtime_samples
ratio above the recorded maximum-noise threshold
ci_gate.cold_over_target_is_not_a_pass: cold_full_body remains over_target=true and is only a regression ceiling until the compositor is improved on a separate authorized change.
